description: Verso is a contemporary residential development by Reportage Properties in Meydan, Dubai, offering one-, two- and four-bedroom apartments within a 15-storey tower. About Verso Verso is a residential development by Reportage Properties in Bukadra, forming part of the wider Meydan Horizon district. The project brings together apartments and ground-level retail within a building organised across two basement levels, a ground floor, two podium levels and 15 residential floors. The residential collection comprises one-, two- and four-bedroom apartments, with published layouts starting at approximately 505 sq. ft. The range is relatively focused, moving from more compact one-bedroom homes to larger four-bedroom residences. The design includes private balconies and terraces, with built-in wardrobes, fully tiled bathrooms, and contemporary kitchen cabinetry and countertops. Large windows, double-glazed glazing and fibre-optic connectivity are among the documented features of the residences. The interiors use a contemporary approach with practical finishes and a neutral palette, keeping the emphasis on straightforward, functional living rather than elaborate detailing. The amenity programme focuses on outdoor recreation, fitness, and family use. A main swimming pool and pool deck sit alongside a children's pool and splash zone, while a padel court, gym and yoga area provide dedicated spaces for exercise. Landscaped areas and shaded seating create quieter outdoor spaces, complemented by children's play facilities and recreational areas including foosball and table tennis. The development's location is a defining characteristic. Bukadra sits within the wider Meydan area, placing Verso within reach of Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall, Dubai Design District, Dubai Creek Harbour and Meydan Racecourse. Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is also nearby, providing a contrasting natural landscape to the increasingly urban surroundings. Verso is therefore positioned around a relatively simple residential proposition: contemporary apartments, a practical amenity programme, and access to several established Dubai destinations, within a district that continues to develop. description: Reference: GTWW-T1353. The development located in Business Bay, Dubai, was conceived as an ultra-luxurious residential tower that asserts itself as one of the tallest and most exclusive housing structures in the world. The building features a striking architecture, inspired by the universe of high jewellery, which is reflected in sculptural shapes, metal inserts, worked decorative elements and meticulous attention to every aesthetic detail. The concept favours not only visual grandeur, but also the creation of sophisticated interiors, highly customisable and developed to offer a level of comfort and refinement rarely found in the residential market. The composition of the tower integrates different categories of housing, aimed at diversified profiles of residents. The initial typologies include two-and-a-half-bedroom residences, designed with functional layouts and a contemporary language, while always maintaining high standards of materials and finishes. Evolving in the range are three-bedroom units, which offer larger areas, harmoniously distributed rooms and rooms with large windows that allow unimpeded views of the Dubai skyline. On the upper levels, typologies of a frankly exclusive character emerge, such as the suspended mansions of four and six bedrooms, which occupy generous areas and provide a true experience of an independent house within a vertical tower. Some of these units include a private pool, cinema rooms, play areas, reading spaces and areas for wellness activities, such as rooms prepared for massages or fully equipped gyms. These residences are also distinguished by the high number of private parking spaces, which can vary between four and twelve, ensuring safety and practicality. At the top of the structure are the most emblematic residences of the project: large penthouses designed in full floors or in duplexes, with exceptional surfaces that far exceed the typical dimensions of luxury apartments. These units include infinity pools with panoramic views, formal and informal dining areas, main kitchens and secondary kitchens for service, private gyms, games rooms, offices, private lounges, suites with walk-in wardrobes, bathrooms covered in noble materials and protected outdoor areas to enjoy the view over the city. In some cases, residents have a private lift with direct access to the interior of the unit, ensuring the highest level of privacy. The building offers an extensive set of amenities that reinforce its position as a reference in the luxury real estate sector. These include large-design outdoor pools, a spa with treatment rooms, a sauna, a Turkish bath and relaxation areas, a gym equipped with state-of-the-art technology, lounges reserved for residents, meeting rooms and social spaces designed for private events. The tower also has concierge services available daily, valet assistance, permanent security staff, high-standard reception and advanced access control systems. The common areas have been carefully planned, using premium materials such as marble, worked metals and architectural lighting, creating an atmosphere of sophistication and exclusivity from the main atrium to the upper floors. The location in Business Bay guarantees a privileged connection to strategic areas of Dubai, such as Downtown, Dubai Canal, financial centres, cultural areas and some of the city's most popular gastronomic and commercial destinations. The proximity to the main traffic routes offers quick accessibility to the airport, beaches and other central neighbourhoods, making the development an ideal option for both permanent residence and investment. Taken together, this tower represents a unique proposition in Dubai's real estate landscape: it combines extremely refined design, typologies adapted to different lifestyles, international standard services and a highly prestigious location. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

title: Dubayy, Dubai
description: Reference: YHKN-T13222. Eywa is an exclusive luxury residential development located along the Dubai Canal in the prestigious district of Business Bay. Inspired by the symbolism of the Tree of Life, the project combines high end architecture with a lifestyle concept focused on wellness, balance, and connection with nature. The building offers a limited collection of just 50 waterfront residences and two ultra luxury penthouses. Apartments range from spacious two to five bedroom layouts, with living areas from approximately 3,064 to over 16,000 square feet. Each residence is designed to maximize natural light and views, featuring expansive terraces, floor to ceiling windows, and natural elements that create a calm and harmonious living environment. The architecture draws inspiration from the organic structure of a banyan tree, with flowing forms and natural materials that give the building its distinctive appearance. Many residences include private pools, waterfalls, and lush greenery, creating a unique indoor outdoor living experience rarely found in city developments. A key element of the project is its focus on holistic well being. Residents have access to a wide range of wellness focused facilities including a luxury spa, yoga and meditation spaces, fitness studio, crystal gardens, and relaxation areas. A distinctive feature of the building is a crystal pyramid integrated within the structure, incorporating thousands of semi precious stones intended to promote positive energy and balance throughout the space. Eywa is also designed with sustainability and health conscious living in mind. The project aims to achieve both LEED Platinum and WELL Platinum certifications, reflecting high standards in energy efficiency, environmental responsibility, and indoor air and water quality. Natural materials such as wood, stone, and clay are used extensively to create warm, natural interiors while reducing environmental impact. Residents benefit from a wide selection of premium amenities including swimming pools, a wellness spa with hammam and sauna, beauty salon, cinema lounge, library, clubhouse dining spaces, and children's activity areas. Additional lifestyle services provide concierge assistance, wellness programs, housekeeping, and other tailored services designed to enhance everyday living. Situated along the scenic Dubai Canal and just minutes from iconic landmarks such as Dubai Fountain, the development offers a peaceful waterfront setting while remaining close to Dubai's major business, shopping, and entertainment destinations. Combining innovative architecture, sustainability, and a wellness driven lifestyle concept, Eywa represents a new standard of luxury living in Dubai where modern comfort meets harmony with nature. title: Dubayy, Dubai
description: Reference: YHKN-T13221. Eywa is an exclusive luxury residential development located along the Dubai Canal in the prestigious district of Business Bay. Inspired by the symbolism of the Tree of Life, the project combines high end architecture with a lifestyle concept focused on wellness, balance, and connection with nature. The building offers a limited collection of just 50 waterfront residences and two ultra luxury penthouses. Apartments range from spacious two to five bedroom layouts, with living areas from approximately 3,064 to over 16,000 square feet. Each residence is designed to maximize natural light and views, featuring expansive terraces, floor to ceiling windows, and natural elements that create a calm and harmonious living environment. The architecture draws inspiration from the organic structure of a banyan tree, with flowing forms and natural materials that give the building its distinctive appearance. Many residences include private pools, waterfalls, and lush greenery, creating a unique indoor outdoor living experience rarely found in city developments. A key element of the project is its focus on holistic well being. Residents have access to a wide range of wellness focused facilities including a luxury spa, yoga and meditation spaces, fitness studio, crystal gardens, and relaxation areas. A distinctive feature of the building is a crystal pyramid integrated within the structure, incorporating thousands of semi precious stones intended to promote positive energy and balance throughout the space. Eywa is also designed with sustainability and health conscious living in mind. The project aims to achieve both LEED Platinum and WELL Platinum certifications, reflecting high standards in energy efficiency, environmental responsibility, and indoor air and water quality. Natural materials such as wood, stone, and clay are used extensively to create warm, natural interiors while reducing environmental impact. Residents benefit from a wide selection of premium amenities including swimming pools, a wellness spa with hammam and sauna, beauty salon, cinema lounge, library, clubhouse dining spaces, and children's activity areas. Additional lifestyle services provide concierge assistance, wellness programs, housekeeping, and other tailored services designed to enhance everyday living. Situated along the scenic Dubai Canal and just minutes from iconic landmarks such as Dubai Fountain, the development offers a peaceful waterfront setting while remaining close to Dubai's major business, shopping, and entertainment destinations. Combining innovative architecture, sustainability, and a wellness driven lifestyle concept, Eywa represents a new standard of luxury living in Dubai where modern comfort meets harmony with nature. title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

The second bedroom measures 3.3 by 4.2 metres and is served by another full bathroom. A separate powder room keeps guest use away from the bedroom accommodation, while a dedicated laundry preserves the kitchen as part of the home's entertaining space. The terrace is the defining room. There is scope for dining near the living room, a more relaxed lounge along the curved frontage and sun loungers beside the private pool. The seventh-floor corner position gives the residence two distinct outlooks. One aspect turns toward the sea; the other takes in Aqua Arc's internal landscape. The view therefore develops as one moves around the terrace rather than presenting a single fixed elevation. Together with the pool and the sweep of the architecture, that dual aspect gives the apartment a sense of privacy and occasion normally associated with a resort home. Aqua Arc's design is shaped by flowing façades, wave-inspired balconies and a restrained coastal palette. The planned amenity programme includes indoor and outdoor fitness areas, walking trails, recreational lawns, barbecue facilities, a pool bar, steam and sauna facilities, and indoor and outdoor children's play areas. description: The development features an exclusive collection of penthouses located on the highest levels, designed to offer a refined lifestyle, panoramic views and an unparalleled residential experience. Located by the sea and integrated in one of the most prestigious points of Dubai Harbour, the development is distinguished by its contemporary architecture, sophisticated interiors and a selection of rare and wide typologies. Within this same development, there is this 3 bedroom flat overlooking the sea, offering a spacious and sophisticated residential experience. This 3 bedroom unit combines the functionality of three bedrooms with high-end finishes, balconies that enhance the view and access to all the exclusive amenities of the condominium, providing comfort, practicality and a premium lifestyle next to the Marina. The five-bedroom penthouses, spread across levels 60 and 61, offer 180-degree views that span Palm Jumeirah, Bluewaters, Ain Dubai, Jbr Beach, Marina Skyline, Dubai Harbour and the open sea. These units have large living and lounge rooms, large dining room, main kitchen and kitchen, private office, home cinema, gym, pool on the balcony, bedrooms with walk-in closet, full service areas and generous balconies that enhance the view and natural light. The total areas of the units vary between about 724.65m² and 799m², including balconies and outdoor storage spaces. The units located on the 60th and 61st floors have the same typology, distinguished mainly by the small variations in indoor and outdoor areas, always maintaining large suites, spacious living areas and privileged views over the sea and the city. Units 6002 and 6102, also with five bedrooms, offer a similar configuration, with subtle differences in the size of the main rooms and leisure spaces, preserving the same level of finish and comfort characteristic of the development. On level 62 is a six-bedroom penthouse with 360-degree views over the entire city. This unit features two master suites with walk-in closet and spa-type bathrooms, cinema room, gym, sauna, hammam, wine room, bar, several living and dining rooms, three separate kitchens, private office, safe room, additional bedrooms with private bathrooms, full service area and multiple storage spaces. With more than 1840m² in total, it represents one of the most imposing and exclusive units of the development. On level 63 is another six-bedroom penthouse, with a similar but even wider layout, with total areas exceeding 1840m². This unit also enjoys completely unobstructed views, multiple social environments, spacious suites, technical and service areas, as well as generous outdoor spaces, designed to provide privacy, comfort and elegance. The finishes present in all units reflect the high standard of the development. The bathrooms include smart toilets and equipment from well-known brands, with premium finish furniture. The kitchens are fully equipped with high-performance appliances, cabinetry in durable materials and double sink. The development also offers several exclusive amenities, such as private outdoor cabanas, Bbq areas, outdoor living areas, leisure spaces and wellness environments integrated into carefully designed green areas. The development redefines the concept of seaside living in Dubai Harbour, combining spaciousness, privacy, excellent finishes and extraordinary views, offering a residential experience of true distinction both in the luxury penthouses and in this 3-bedroom flat with sea views, ideal for those looking for comfort, exclusivity and sophistication. description: The development features an exclusive collection of penthouses located on the highest levels, designed to offer a refined lifestyle, panoramic views and an unparalleled residential experience. Located by the sea and integrated in one of the most prestigious points of Dubai Harbour, the development is distinguished by its contemporary architecture, sophisticated interiors and a selection of rare and wide typologies. The five-bedroom penthouses, spread across levels 60 and 61, offer 180-degree views that span Palm Jumeirah, Bluewaters, Ain Dubai, Jbr Beach, Marina Skyline, Dubai Harbour and the open sea. These units have large living and lounge rooms, large dining room, main kitchen and kitchen, private office, home cinema, gym, pool on the balcony, bedrooms with walk-in closet, full service areas and generous balconies that enhance the view and natural light. Total unit areas range between about 7,800 and 8,600 sq.ft, including balconies and outdoor storage spaces. The units located on floors 6001 and 6101 have the same typology, distinguished mainly by the small variations in indoor and outdoor area, always maintaining large suites, spacious living areas and privileged views over the sea and the city. Units 6002 and 6102, also with five bedrooms, offer a similar configuration, with subtle differences in the size of the main rooms and leisure spaces, preserving the same level of finish and comfort characteristic of the development. On level 62 is a six-bedroom penthouse with 360-degree views over the entire city. This unit features two master suites with walk-in closet and spa-type bathrooms, cinema room, gym, sauna, hammam, wine room, bar, several living and dining rooms, three separate kitchens, private office, safe room, additional bedrooms with private bathrooms, full service area and multiple storage spaces. With more than 19,000 sq.ft total, it represents one of the most imposing and exclusive units in the development. On the 63rd level is another six-bedroom penthouse, with a similar but even wider layout, with total areas exceeding 19,800 sq.ft. This unit also enjoys completely unobstructed views, multiple social environments, spacious suites, technical and service areas, as well as generous outdoor spaces, designed to provide privacy, comfort and elegance. The finishes present in all units reflect the high standard of the development. The bathrooms include smart toilets and equipment from well-known brands, with premium finish furniture. The kitchens are fully equipped with high-performance appliances, cabinetry in durable materials and double sink. The development also offers several exclusive amenities, such as private outdoor cabanas, Bbq areas, outdoor living areas, leisure spaces and wellness environments integrated into carefully designed green areas. The development redefines the concept of seaside living in Dubai Harbour, combining spaciousness, privacy, excellent finishes and extraordinary views, resulting in a residential offering of true distinction. description: The Arabian Gulf does not offer this view to everyone. At Samana Ocean Crest, it comes with your morning coffee. Fifty-six residences. One island. No compromise. Developed by Samana Developers - ranked fifth among Dubai's highest off-plan sellers by volume in the first half of 2025, with a portfolio valued at over AED 17 billion - Ocean Crest represents the developer's most considered coastal statement to date. Positioned on Dubai Islands, the Nakheel-masterplanned destination that redefines what island living means in this city, the project rises across eight residential floors with a discipline of scale that most developers would not allow themselves: just 56 residences, each one crafted with the attention that only boutique numbers permit. Many homes feature private terrace pools, interiors finished in warm natural stone, wood, and glass, and layouts calibrated around panoramic sea and skyline perspectives. Samana has built its reputation on delivering resort-style living as a lived experience rather than a marketing promise - and Ocean Crest is where that philosophy meets the Gulf itself. THE EXPERIENCE: Life at Ocean Crest operates at the cadence of the sea. Mornings open to the Arabian Gulf with no obstruction, afternoons unfold across a resort-grade amenity landscape, and evenings carry the particular stillness that only island addresses can offer. This is not urban living softened by a view. It is coastal living, fully committed. Private terrace pools - select residences with direct pool access from your own outdoor space Infinity pool and sun deck - a skyline-facing water environment designed for unhurried days Yoga studios and wellness spaces - dedicated areas for restoration alongside the water's edge Spa, sauna, and steam rooms - a full wellness facility integrated into the building's daily rhythm Children's splash pad and family zones - thoughtfully separated spaces for every generation Landscaped gardens and jogging tracks - green corridors woven into the island environment 24/7 concierge and artistic lobby - a resident arrival experience that sets the register from the first step THE INVESTMENT CASE: Dubai Islands is one of the few remaining large-scale waterfront destinations in Dubai where early capital allocation still carries meaningful upside - a Nakheel-developed master community with confirmed infrastructure, beach access, and a pipeline of hospitality and retail that will anchor long-term demand. Ocean Crest's boutique scale of 56 residences operates as a natural scarcity lever in a market where oversupply is the persistent structural risk. Samana's 86% foreign investor demand ratio confirms the international conviction behind the developer's product - and a freehold title on a beachfront island address, at a confirmed entry point of AED 2.2M, positions this well within reach of the buyer profile that this location will continue to attract. With handover in Q3 2028 and a 20/70/10 payment plan, the capital deployment is structured to carry investors through the community's most active development phase. WHO THIS IS FOR: This is for those who have spent enough time in landlocked buildings and have decided, with some finality, that the water is non-negotiable. People who want their Dubai address to signal something more specific than premium - something coastal, considered, and genuinely rare at this scale. Buyers who understand the arithmetic of boutique beachfront freehold on an emerging island master plan, and who also simply want to swim in their own pool on a Tuesday morning with nothing but the Gulf in front of them. Ocean Crest. Fifty-six chances to own the edge of the island.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: Branded Luxury Apartments with Installments in Downtown Dubai Downtown Dubai is the city's vibrant flagship district, renowned for its iconic landmarks, world-class lifestyle, and unmatched investment appeal. Home to the majestic Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall, and the captivating Dubai Fountain, it offers a perfect blend of luxury living, entertainment, and cultural experiences. Rising 71 stories above Dubai's iconic Sheikh Zayed Road, this architectural masterpiece is shaped as a gently curving prism inspired by desert winds, creating a striking landmark on the city skyline. description: Beachfront Apartments with Installments on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island in Umm Al-Quwain is a stunning haven that blends luxurious living with breathtaking natural surroundings. This exclusive community offers a range of upscale residences, including waterfront villas and elegant apartments, thoughtfully crafted for a sophisticated island lifestyle. Residents benefit from direct beach access, expansive green spaces, and world-class amenities such as an 18-hole golf course, eco-park, and water sports adventures. With its rich ecological diversity and cultural heritage, Siniyah Island provides a peaceful escape just 50 minutes from Dubai, perfectly balancing tranquility and urban convenience. Umm Al Quwain are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious lifestyle harmoniously integrated with natural beauty, featuring state-of-the-art residential units within multi-use towers ranging from 2 to 10 stories. The development is surrounded by pristine white sand beaches, lush mangroves, and a rich tapestry of unique wildlife. Community amenities include a recreational fishing deck, family-oriented golf course, event cabanas, al fresco dining, and luxury beach cabanas. A seawater lagoon is central to the community, providing facilities for non-motorized water sports such as snorkeling, paddleboarding, kayaking, and floating cinema experiences. Linear parks are equipped with yoga decks, wellness parks, and sports facilities like tennis and paddle courts, alongside skateboarding zones. Additional highlights include a yacht club, mosque, retail mall, public beach, and helicopter landing pad. Residents can enjoy a clubhouse with a gym, library lounge, steam and sauna rooms, and multipurpose spaces. The development also prioritizes sustainability with double-glazed façades, energy-efficient systems, and provisions for electric vehicle charging. The project features meticulously designed interiors that combine elegance with functionality, offering 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments with spacious layouts and high-quality finishes. Each unit is equipped with fitted wardrobes and kitchens that include premium white goods such as an oven, gas hob and hood, refrigerator, and washing machine. The living and bedroom areas are adorned with porcelain tile flooring and finished with matte emulsion paint walls for a sleek yet cozy ambiance. The master bedrooms boast en-suite bathrooms, while all bathrooms and powder rooms are outfitted with premium-brand water closets, washbasins, and chrome-plated fittings. Kitchens feature high-quality reconstituted stone countertops and laminate or high-gloss PET-finished cabinets. description: Exclusive Beachfront Apartments with Installment on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a site of significant historical and ecological importance. Archaeological excavations have uncovered the oldest known pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf on the island, dating back to the late 6th or early 7th century CE. Additionally, the discovery of an Eastern Christian monastery from the same period provides insight into the region's diverse cultural heritage. The island is also home to one of the largest remaining colonies of Socotra cormorants, highlighting its environmental significance. Recognizing its potential, the Umm Al Quwain government has initiated a development project to introduce leisure, hotel, and residential properties to Siniyah Island, aiming to blend its rich history with modern amenities. , are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious seaside lifestyle, set amidst lush landscapes and serene surroundings. It seamlessly integrates natural beauty and refined architectural design, boasting pristine beaches with velvety white sands and crystal-clear turquoise waters. Residents enjoy direct beach and lagoon access, expansive views of the Arabian Gulf, and lush green vistas overlooking a meticulously designed 18-hole golf course. The development features premium amenities including an infinity swimming pool, an outdoor cinema, a state-of-the-art fitness centre, and multiple children's play areas. For leisure and relaxation, landscaped parks, tranquil gardens, and a vibrant community centre provide perfect spaces to unwind. Additionally, thrill-seekers can indulge in exhilarating water sports such as scuba diving, snorkeling, kite surfing, and paddleboarding. The retail boulevard offers a sensory feast with charming cafes and gourmet dining, enhancing the vibrant community atmosphere. Exclusive services such as a yacht club, a shopping mall, luxury resorts, and a helipad further elevate the sophisticated lifestyle experience provided by this prestigious island residence. title: Emaar Pier Point
description:
Pier Point is a waterfront residential development by Emaar Properties, located within Rashid Yachts & Marina at Mina Rashid, Dubai. The project comprises two residential towers connected by a landscaped podium, offering a selection of one, two and three-bedroom apartments, along with three-bedroom townhouses. Designed around contemporary architecture and marina-facing views, the development combines modern residential interiors with landscaped communal spaces and direct access to the waterfront promenade.
The apartments feature practical layouts with open-plan living and dining areas, kitchens, private balconies and dedicated utility spaces. One-bedroom residences include a bedroom, walk-in wardrobe, bathroom, living room and separate laundry area. Two-bedroom apartments provide additional living space, with a master bedroom featuring a walk-in wardrobe and en-suite bathroom, a second bathroom and balconies in various layouts. Three-bedroom apartments offer larger interiors, spacious balconies, multiple bathrooms and additional utility or storage areas, with study spaces available in selected layouts.
The three-bedroom townhouses offer larger multi-level living arrangements, with three bedrooms, a maidâs room, multiple bathrooms, storage areas, laundry facilities and private outdoor spaces. These layouts provide additional flexibility for families seeking more space within a waterfront residential community.
Residents can enjoy a range of recreational facilities, including an infinity swimming pool with views, a fitness centre, children's play areas, multipurpose rooms, landscaped gardens and a yoga deck. The wider Rashid Yachts & Marina community provides access to a full-service marina, waterfront promenade, retail outlets, dining options and nearby leisure attractions, including the QE2 floating hotel.
Pier Point also benefits from road connectivity to major destinations across Dubai. Sheikh Zayed Road is approximately 10 minutes away, Dubai International Airport around 15 minutes away, and Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa and Dubai Creek Harbour approximately 20 minutes away, subject to traffic conditions. With its waterfront setting, contemporary residences and range of apartment and townhouse options, Pier Point offers an appealing choice for families, end-users and investors seeking marina-side living in Dubai.

description: Reference: YHKN-T13217. Eywa is an exclusive luxury residential development located along the Dubai Canal in the prestigious district of Business Bay. Inspired by the symbolism of the Tree of Life, the project combines high end architecture with a lifestyle concept focused on wellness, balance, and connection with nature. The building offers a limited collection of just 50 waterfront residences and two ultra luxury penthouses. Apartments range from spacious two to five bedroom layouts, with living areas from approximately 3,064 to over 16,000 square feet. Each residence is designed to maximize natural light and views, featuring expansive terraces, floor to ceiling windows, and natural elements that create a calm and harmonious living environment. The architecture draws inspiration from the organic structure of a banyan tree, with flowing forms and natural materials that give the building its distinctive appearance. Many residences include private pools, waterfalls, and lush greenery, creating a unique indoor outdoor living experience rarely found in city developments. A key element of the project is its focus on holistic well being. Residents have access to a wide range of wellness focused facilities including a luxury spa, yoga and meditation spaces, fitness studio, crystal gardens, and relaxation areas. A distinctive feature of the building is a crystal pyramid integrated within the structure, incorporating thousands of semi precious stones intended to promote positive energy and balance throughout the space. Eywa is also designed with sustainability and health conscious living in mind. The project aims to achieve both LEED Platinum and WELL Platinum certifications, reflecting high standards in energy efficiency, environmental responsibility, and indoor air and water quality. Natural materials such as wood, stone, and clay are used extensively to create warm, natural interiors while reducing environmental impact. Residents benefit from a wide selection of premium amenities including swimming pools, a wellness spa with hammam and sauna, beauty salon, cinema lounge, library, clubhouse dining spaces, and children's activity areas. Additional lifestyle services provide concierge assistance, wellness programs, housekeeping, and other tailored services designed to enhance everyday living. Situated along the scenic Dubai Canal and just minutes from iconic landmarks such as Dubai Fountain, the development offers a peaceful waterfront setting while remaining close to Dubai's major business, shopping, and entertainment destinations. Combining innovative architecture, sustainability, and a wellness driven lifestyle concept, Eywa represents a new standard of luxury living in Dubai where modern comfort meets harmony with nature. description: Apartments in Opus with World Famous Design in Dubai Business Bay The ultra-luxury apartments are located in Opus in Dubai Business Bay. This architectural wonder not only attracts attention with its unique design but also serves as a vibrant cultural and artistic center. Opus is designed as two separate towers that coalesce into a single whole, taking the shape of a cube. The cube is then ''carved'' to create a central void within the building, which is an important volume in its own right and provides a view from the center of the building to the exterior. The two towers are linked by a four-story atrium at ground level with a bridge connecting 71 meters above the ground. The bridge is constructed with double-curved glass, double-curved aluminum frames, and steel elements. The bridge consists of three storeys offering spectacular views and the feeling of being at the top. The 96 units in Opus are available in a range of sizes, from one and two-bedroom apartments to exceptional duplexes and triplexes. description: We offer for sale a 2-room apartment with a rental contract, with an area of 88 m² , in the popular Zabeel area. The apartment is located in the new residential complex 1 Residences. It is fully renovated and equipped with furniture and appliances. The offered apartment is on a high floor, with a well-thought-out and convenient layout, a spacious balcony, and panoramic views of the park. The bright interior is designed in a modern style in cool tones with marble and tiles. The apartment has 1 parking space in the underground garage. Starting price - EUR 585,830. About the project 1 Residences is a complex of two original towers in the shape of the number "1" in the historic district of Bur Dubai. The 43-storey buildings are elegantly connected at the top levels by a skybridge. Construction of the project was completed in 2022. Infrastructure On the podium level of the complex and the top three floors, public areas with landscaping and premium amenities have been created for residents and guests of 1 Residences. These include swimming pools with lounge areas, fountains, children's playgrounds, a modern gym, a 340-meter running track on the 43rd floor, and much more. The 1 Residences complex is located in Al Kifaf, near Dubai's popular historic district of Bur Dubai. The area includes many historic sites: the Dubai Museum in 18th-century style, the historic Al Bastakiya quarter, and more. The active residence of the Emir of Dubai, Zabeel Palace, is also located here. The district's special attractions include the grand viewing platform Dubai Frame and Zabeel Park. The park can be considered a huge green oasis. There you will find dinosaur sculptures, illuminated gardens, an ice park with children's rides, barbecue pavilions, and a running track with non-slip coating and aroma diffuser. All these locations are within a 5-10 minute drive from the complex. It takes five minutes by car to reach Dubai's main highway, Sheikh Zayed Road, which runs along the coast. This highway provides quick access to any location in Dubai, as well as to the neighboring emirates of Abu Dhabi and Sharjah. The apartments in 1 Residences appeal to lovers of luxury and active lifestyles who want to enjoy comfort in a modern residential complex with unique architecture. The strategic proximity to the center of Dubai, business districts, and the airport highlights the convenience of living in 1 Residences.

description: Discover a new residential landmark in the heart of Dubai. An exceptional T1 with direct views of the canal, set in an iconic 450-metre, 109-storey tower that redefines the concept of living above the city. At the highest point, at about 370 meters, is a true resort environment with an infinity pool and floating deck, where the sunset over the horizon becomes part of the daily routine. The experience begins in the lobby, a space that combines stone, wood and metallic details to create a sense of tranquillity and grandeur, marking the architectural elegance of the project from the first step.
